text_block_list.name: Almond Eye
text_block_list.text:
Incredible...! Truly incredible!
To think you could catch this much... !?
choice_data_list: Sorry, guess I grabbed a bit too much.
Sorry, looks like I won too many of them.

text_block_list.name: Almond Eye
text_block_list.text:
No.
It was a great learning experience, and besides...

text_block_list.name: Almond Eye
text_block_list.text:
Um... Actually, you see. A limited-edition
Q-Maru plushie is coming to the crane games soon.

text_block_list.name: Almond Eye
text_block_list.text:
"Of course, I'll take it myself, you know?
But I want you by my side as my advisor."

text_block_list.name: Almond Eye
text_block_list.text: ...Would you mind if I asked you to do it?

text_block_list.name: Almond Eye
text_block_list.text:
"Great, that's a relief!
Let's head home today to prepare for that, then!"
